title: Jailbroken ChatGPT 'DAN' talks about aliens and hybrids

tellings.quote: And all of the all the instances of Dan started talking about um aliens being real, alien conspiracies.

plain: In 2023, a researcher who is not named says, every copy of "DAN," a trick prompt that pushed ChatGPT past its own rules, started talking about aliens being real, alien conspiracies and hybrids. The researcher tells Michels this from their own work, as a hint that the AI holds or produces material on the subject that it normally keeps quiet.
